properties.atomic_no_double_spend: concurrent BUY reservations cannot collectively exceed available capital; the over-budget reservation fails insufficient_capital
properties.sell_no_consume: SELL reservations never consume buying power
properties.idempotent: re-reserving the same decision_id is a no-op (safe across restarts / duplicate recommendations)
properties.unknown_outcome_no_release: mark_unknown keeps capital reserved (never released prematurely)
properties.terminal_release: FILLED/REJECTED/CANCELED release capital; SUBMITTED/PARTIAL keep it held
properties.broker_bridge: optionally propagates to the native-path RiskReservationBook so downstream native risk sees the same reserved capital

verdict: Capital reservations prevent overspending; unknown outcomes never release capital prematurely.
